senses: v. 印刷;打印;出版,刊登;洗印
n. 打印机;印刷商,印刷工人;印刷公司,印刷厂
n. [U,C] （计算机）打印件，打印资料
adj. 先前的；较早的；在前的；优先的
prior.usage: pre（先）→prior（在前的）→priority（优先权）；辨析: former(两者中)前者的; preceding 强调时间或位置紧接前面; previous 专指时间上较早; prior 与 previous 几乎同义,还暗含更重要,常与 to 连用；adj.先前的；优先的，更重要的； 在前面的 n.犯罪前科

ex.en: This information must not be disclosed without prior written consent.
ex.zh: 未事先征得书面许可，此消息不得泄露。

ex.en: No prior experience is required for this training programme.
ex.zh: 这项培训计划不要求有以往的经验。

ex.en: Prior to the meeting, the two sides exchanged draft agreements.
ex.zh: 会前，双方交换了协议草案。

senses: vt. 确定优先顺序；优先考虑
prioritise.usage: 书中亦作prioritize；2019年真题义：优先考虑（最易发生火灾或干旱的区域）

ex.en: Another approach to getting more done in less time is to rethink how you prioritise your day.
ex.zh: 在更少的时间内完成更多工作的另一个方法就是重新考虑一天之中的事情孰轻孰重。

ex.en: Another approach to getting more done in less time is to rethink how you prioritize your day—in particular how we craft our to-do lists.
ex.zh: 另外一个在更短时间内搞定更多事情的办法是，重新思考一下你是如何按照优先顺序安排你的一天的——尤其是我们如何巧妙地安排我们的待办清单。

prioritize.usage: v.按优先顺序列出；优先考虑

senses: n. 优先权；优先考虑的事
n. 优先事项,最重要的事
n. 优先权；优先事项；最重要的事；首要事情

phrases.m: 将…置于比…更优先的位置

priority.usage: 同义: precedence；词根记忆：pri(first, 优先的)+or(表比较)+ity→比较而言是优先的→优先事项；索引p414

ex.en: The Conservatives' planning reform explicitly gives rural development priority over conservation.
ex.zh: 保守党的规划改革明确提出乡村开发相比保护拥有优先权。

ex.en: They give priority to the most urgent task on hand.
ex.zh: 他们优先处理手头最紧迫的任务。

ex.en: The Conservatives' planning reform explicitly gives rural development priority over conservation, even authorizing "off-plan" building where local people might object.
ex.zh: 保守党正在计划的改革明确地将乡村的开发置于比乡村保护更优先的位置，甚至批准当地人民可能反对的期房修建。

ex.en: Many users worry that these apps collect personal data and threaten their privacy.
ex.zh: 许多用户担心这些应用程序收集个人数据并威胁其隐私。

ex.en: The fence was built to protect the family's privacy.
ex.zh: 修建栅栏是为了保护这个家庭的隐私。

ex.en: Celebrities often complain that the media invade their privacy.
ex.zh: 名人们常常抱怨媒体侵犯他们的隐私。

senses: adj. 私人的,个人的;秘密的;私立的,私营的
adj. 私人的，私密的；私有的；私立的
private.usage: 辨析: private 私人的,私立的,指属于私人所有或具私营性质,含明确的隐私意味,可用于人和组织机构; personal 私人的,个人的,指属于或关于某人,通常只能用于人；另：private business owners私营企业主；索引p414

ex.en: Citizens still have a right to expect private documents to remain private and protected by the Constitution's prohibition on unreasonable searches.
ex.zh: 公民仍然有权要求私人文件保持私密性，并受到宪法禁止无理搜查的保护。

ex.en: Discussing the issue in private will make the powerful person feel less threatened.
ex.zh: 与当权者私下讨论这个问题会让对方感觉不那么受威胁。

ex.en: More and more parents send their children to private schools.
ex.zh: 越来越多的父母把孩子送进私立学校。

ex.en: Many officials privately doubt that the target can be reached.
ex.zh: 许多官员私下怀疑这一目标能否实现。

ex.en: The two leaders met privately before making any public statement.
ex.zh: 两位领导人在发表任何公开声明之前先举行了私下会晤。

ex.en: The firm is privately owned and does not publish its accounts.
ex.zh: 这家公司为私人所有，不公布其账目。

senses: vt. 给予特权；特别优待
n. 特殊的待遇,特殊的荣幸
privilege.usage: [族] privileged a. 享有特权的；同义: advantage；n.特权；荣幸，光荣；权势 v.给予特权，特别优待；priv（私人的）+i+leg（法律）+e→私人的权利→特权；词根记忆：pri(peculiar, 特殊的)+vi+leg(law, 法律)+e→法律上给予特殊照顾→特权；索引p414

ex.en: Education should be a universal right and not a privilege.
ex.zh: 教育应当是全民共有的而非少数人独享的权利。

ex.en: These are the kind of workers that countries like Britain, Canada and Australia try to attract by using immigration rules that privilege college graduates.
ex.zh: 这些正是英国、加拿大和澳大利亚这样的国家通过施行赋予大学毕业生以特权的移民法来努力吸引的那类工作人员。

ex.en: In some countries, quality health care remains a privilege of the rich.
ex.zh: 在一些国家，优质的医疗服务仍是富人的特权。

senses: a. 有特权的；荣幸；特许保密的

ex.en: But all too often such policies only benefits the most privileged and does little to help average people.
ex.zh: 但这些政策往往只惠及最有特权的人，对普通人帮助甚微。

prize.usage: 助记:用大price(价钱)去买prize(奖品)；索引p414

ex.en: "There is one and only one social responsibility of businesses," Wrote Milton Friedman, a Nobel prize-winning economist, "That is, to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits."
ex.zh: 诺贝尔经济学奖获得者米尔顿·弗里德曼曾写道,"企业有且只有一种责任,即为增加利润而运用资源,开展活动。"

ex.en: Across generational lines, Americans continue to prize many of the same traditional milestones of a successful life, including getting married, having children, owning a home, and retiring in their sixties.
ex.zh: 美国几代人都一直看重许多同样的、传统意义上的成功人生里程碑，包括结婚、生子、买房和在60多岁的时候退休。

ex.en: She won first prize in the national writing competition, an honour she had dreamed of since childhood.
ex.zh: 她在全国写作比赛中获得一等奖，这是她自幼梦想的荣誉。

senses: n. 可能性；可能发生的事情

ex.en: A fall in interest rates is a strong probability in the present economic climate.
ex.zh: 在目前的经济形势下，降低利率大有可能。

ex.en: They found that after a surprise departure, the probability that the company will subsequently have to restate earnings increased by nearly 20%.
ex.zh: 他们发现（独立董事）“突然”离职后，公司随后不得不重述其收益报告的概率增加了近20%。

ex.en: There is a high probability that the new policy will face opposition from small businesses.
ex.zh: 新政策极有可能遭到小企业的反对。

senses: adj. 很可能的,大概的;有希望的
probable.usage: 辨析:probable主观上有根据的推测,十有八九可能;possible客观潜在可能性,十有二三;likely可能性介于两者之间;派生probably adv.很可能,大概,或许

ex.en: The two outcomes are equally probable.
ex.zh: 两种结果都同样有可能。

ex.en: It is highly probable that the missing papers were destroyed years ago.
ex.zh: 那些失踪的文件极有可能多年前就已被销毁。

ex.en: Rain is probable tomorrow, so take an umbrella with you.
ex.zh: 明天可能下雨，带上伞吧。

senses: n. 探索,探查;探针,探测器

phrases.p: adequately probe social and biological factors
phrases.m: 充分调查社会和生物因素

probe.usage: pro(往前)+be(是)→是往前的→一再地往前，就是在"探究，追问"；索引p414

ex.en: He didn't like the media probing into his past.
ex.zh: 他不喜欢媒体追问他的过去。

ex.en: The government has ordered a full probe into the collapse of the bridge.
ex.zh: 政府已下令对大桥倒塌事件展开全面调查。

ex.en: Scientists sent a probe to collect data from the surface of Mars.
ex.zh: 科学家发射了一个探测器，从火星表面收集数据。

senses: n. （商业、法律或政治上的）程序
procedure.usage: n.步骤；程序；手术；行进（proceed）的每一步就是程序，步骤（procedure）；词根记忆：pro(toward,向前)+ced(go,走)+ure→按照程序不断走流程→程序；索引p414

ex.en: To ensure high quality, all products go through rigorous testing procedures.
ex.zh: 为了确保高质量，所有产品都经过严格的测试程序。

ex.en: The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
ex.zh: 泰勒案的决议还声明陪审团选任过程中的性别歧视是违反宪法的，并要求各州依据同样的程序来选取男女陪审员。

ex.en: Follow the standard procedure in case of a fire.
ex.zh: 遇到火灾时请遵循标准程序。

senses: vi. (尤指停顿或打断后)继续进行
v. 继续做；接着做；行进；前往
vi. 继续做（或从事、进行）
proceed.usage: pro（向前）+ceed（走）→往前走→继续做；索引p414

ex.en: This project cannot be allowed to proceed.
ex.zh: 这个项目不能再进行下去了。

ex.en: After a short break, the meeting proceeded with the second item on the agenda.
ex.zh: 短暂休息后，会议继续进行议程的第二项。

ex.en: The police said they would proceed with the investigation despite the lack of evidence.
ex.zh: 警方表示，尽管缺乏证据，他们仍将继续调查。

proceeding.usage: n.诉讼；事件，(一连串)发生的事； 记录

ex.en: The new rules are designed to speed up legal proceedings in commercial disputes.
ex.zh: 新规则旨在加快商业纠纷的法律程序。

ex.en: The society publishes the proceedings of its annual meeting every spring.
ex.zh: 该学会每年春季出版年会论文集。

ex.en: He began proceedings against the builder over the faulty roof.
ex.zh: 他就屋顶的质量问题对建筑商提起了诉讼。

senses: n. 公报；（会议等的）正式记录；诉讼

ex.en: That is what a study, published from the University of California and Yale University in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, has concluded.
ex.zh: 这是加利福尼亚大学和耶鲁大学的研究人员发表在美国国家科学院院刊上的一项研究的结论。

senses: n. 工序;制作方法,加工方法

phrases.p: the process of economic and social development
phrases.m: 经济与社会发展的进程

phrases.p: in the process of doing sth

process.usage: n.步骤，程序；进程 v.处理，加工；审核；易混：proceed动，继续做/行进；proceeds名，（售物或演出等）收入，非proceed的复数；proceed无名词词性；索引p414

ex.en: But demanding too much of air travelers or providing too little security in return undermines public support for the process.
ex.zh: 但是对乘客要求过多而作为回报提供的安全保障又太少,逐渐影响了人们对安检过程的支持。

ex.en: When food is processed, many of the nutrients are stripped away.
ex.zh: 食物经过加工后很多营养素都流失了。

ex.en: High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weakened the forms and processes by which teachers and students are admitted into a community of scholars during periods of stability or slow growth.
ex.zh: 高增长率增加了学术创新的机会，但它们也削弱了教师和学生在稳定期或缓慢增长期间被纳入学术团队的形式和流程。

procession.usage: pro（加强）+cess（行进）+ion（表行为）→列队行进→队伍

ex.en: The procession is advancing successively.
ex.zh: 队伍一直在前进。

ex.en: A long procession of mourners followed the coffin through the narrow streets.
ex.zh: 长长的送葬队伍护送灵柩穿过狭窄的街道。

ex.en: Cars moved in a slow procession through the flooded main street.
ex.zh: 汽车排成长队缓缓驶过被淹的大街。

senses: n. 加工机(或工人);处理器,处理机
n. (计算机的)处理器；加工机(或工人)

ex.en: The new laptop uses a faster processor that consumes less power.
ex.zh: 这款新笔记本电脑采用速度更快、功耗更低的处理器。

ex.en: A word processor makes editing and formatting documents much easier.
ex.zh: 文字处理器使文档的编辑和排版容易得多。

ex.en: The food processor can chop vegetables within seconds.
ex.zh: 这种食品加工机几秒钟就能把蔬菜切碎。

phrases.p: proclaim the character of the town
phrases.m: 成为这个城镇的特色标志

proclaim.usage: pro-（向前）+claim（喊）→向前面的人们喊→宣布；记：pro-（公开）+claim（告诉）→公开告诉大家某事→宣布；辨析:declare指正式公开宣布;proclaim指正式场合公布重大事件,主语多为权力机关;pronounce指正式严肃地宣称;announce含预告,常经媒体正式通报；v.宣告，声明；表明，显

ex.en: The president proclaimed a state of emergency.
ex.zh: 总统宣布了紧急状态。

ex.en: The government proclaimed a national day of mourning for the victims of the disaster.
ex.zh: 政府宣布为灾难遇难者举行全国哀悼日。

ex.en: The novel proclaimed the arrival of a bold new literary talent.
ex.zh: 这部小说宣告了一位大胆的文学新人的到来。

senses: n. [C] 奇才；天才；（惊人的）奇观
prodigy.usage: pro-（向前）+dig（说）→被公认为超前的人→奇才。prodigious a.巨大的；惊人的

senses: vt. 生产,制造;产生;引起,导致
vt. 提出;出示,拿出;上演,演出
vt. 生产；引起；培养；制作（电影、杂志、唱片等）

ex.en: Evidence that the loveLife program produces lasting changes is limited and mixed.
ex.zh: 能证明“珍爱生命”项目引起了持久改变的证据有限且含糊不清。

ex.en: The factory produces more than a thousand cars every week.
ex.zh: 这家工厂每周生产一千多辆汽车。

ex.en: She produced a letter to support her argument in court.
ex.zh: 她拿出了一封信，在法庭上支持自己的论点。

senses: n. [C] （自然、化学或工业过程的）产物
product.usage: 辨析:product指体脑劳动产物,多指工业品,可数;produce指未加工农产品等总称,不可数;production指总产量,也指文艺作品；n.产品，制品；生成物；乘积；派生by-product n.副产品；索引p414

ex.en: The company sells its products around the world.
ex.zh: 该公司在世界各地销售其产品。

ex.en: I do completely agree that fears are just the product of our luxuriant imagination.
ex.zh: 恐惧只是我们丰富的想象力的产物，这一点我完全赞同。

ex.en: The company recalled its main product after reports of safety problems.
ex.zh: 在接到安全问题报告后，该公司召回了其主打产品。

senses: n. 生产；产量；产生；（电影、戏剧等的）制作
production.usage: n.生产，制造；产量；产生； 制作；索引p414

ex.en: The production of steel consumes enormous amounts of energy.
ex.zh: 钢铁生产消耗大量能源。

ex.en: Rising costs have forced the company to cut production by ten percent.
ex.zh: 成本上升迫使公司将产量削减了百分之十。

ex.en: The theatre's new production of the play opens next month.
ex.zh: 这部戏的新制作版本下个月将在剧院上演。

senses: adj. 生产的；（尤指）多产的；有效益的，富有成效的
adj. 多产的；富有成效的
productive.usage: adj.多产的；有效益的，富有 成效的；生产的；索引p414

ex.en: My time spent in the library was very productive.
ex.zh: 我花在图书馆的时间很有收获。

ex.en: The talks between the two leaders were described as frank and productive.
ex.zh: 两位领导人之间的会谈被描述为坦率而富有成效。

ex.en: A quiet environment helps employees stay productive throughout the day.
ex.zh: 安静的环境有助于员工全天保持高效工作。

ex.en: Productivity is growing at a very healthy rate.
ex.zh: 生产力正以一个非常健康的速度增长。

ex.en: The introduction of new technology greatly improved productivity in the factory.
ex.zh: 新技术的引进大大提高了工厂的生产率。

ex.en: Managers should focus on raising productivity rather than simply extending working hours.
ex.zh: 管理者应致力于提高生产效率，而不是单纯延长工作时间。

profess.usage: vt.声称，伪称；公开承认；信仰； 传授

senses: n. [C] 职业（需专门训练的）
n. 职业，行业；表白；声明
profession.usage: 辨析:profession指受过高等教育和特别训练的职业;post/position指特定岗位;trade指技术性行当;vocation指尤适合的职业;career指终身职业；n.职业；pro（前，公开）+fess（说，表白）+ion（名词词尾）→在众人面前公开说，公开表白→表白。派生：professional；辨：强

ex.en: He was a lawyer by profession.
ex.zh: 他的职业是律师。

ex.en: Teaching is a profession that demands both knowledge and devotion.
ex.zh: 教师是一种既需要知识又需要奉献精神的职业。

ex.en: She decided to enter the medical profession after graduation.
ex.zh: 她决定毕业后从事医疗行业。

senses: n. 自由职业者,专业人员

ex.en: You need a professional to sort out your finances.
ex.zh: 你需要专业人员替你理财。

ex.en: You should consult a professional lawyer before signing the contract.
ex.zh: 签合同前你应该咨询专业律师。

ex.en: Her professional attitude impressed every member of the interview panel.
ex.zh: 她专业的态度给面试小组的每位成员都留下了深刻印象。

senses: n. 职业化；专业化过程

professionalism.usage: n.专业主义；专业技能，专业水准；索引p414

senses: vt. 使专业化；使职业化

ex.en: Besides professionalising the professions by this separation, top American universities have professionalised the professor.
ex.zh: 除了通过这种分离（指文科教育和专业教育的分离）而实现学科的专业化以外，美国的一流大学也对教授实行了专业化。

senses: v. 使专业化,使职业化
n. [C] 教授；（大学的）讲师，教员

ex.en: She was appointed professor of economics at the age of thirty-five.
ex.zh: 她三十五岁时被聘为经济学教授。

ex.en: The professor encouraged his students to question accepted theories.
ex.zh: 这位教授鼓励学生质疑公认的理论。

ex.en: Many professors argue that online courses cannot replace classroom teaching.
ex.zh: 许多教授认为在线课程无法取代课堂教学。

senses: n. 教授的级别(或职位)等

proficiency.usage: 助记:pro(前)+fic(做)+iency→提前把事情做好→熟练,精通

senses: adj. 熟练的,精通的;训练有素的
proficient.usage: pro（向前，在前）+fic（做）+i（我）+ent→在别人前面做示范→熟练；索引p414

ex.en: He's proficient at his job.
ex.zh: 他的工作效率很高。

ex.en: She is proficient in three languages, including Mandarin.
ex.zh: 她精通包括普通话在内的三种语言。

ex.en: Only regular practice will make you proficient at a musical instrument.
ex.zh: 只有坚持练习才能让你熟练掌握一门乐器。

senses: n. 概述,简介,传略；v. 概述,写简介
n. 轮廓；外形；概述，简介；印象；形象
n. 简介；形象；轮廓；侧影
profile.usage: pro（从前面）+file（音似“肥了”）→从前面看你的轮廓肥了→轮廓；联想记忆: pro(before, 在前)+file(文件)→在文件的最前面→简介；索引p414

ex.en: The deal will certainly raise the company's international profile.
ex.zh: 这宗交易肯定会提高这家公司的国际形象。

ex.en: The magazine published a profile of the young entrepreneur last week.

ex.zh: 定期的检测使老师能监测每个孩子的进步。

ex.en: Scientific method, reductionism and the questioning of Church ideals was to be encouraged, as were ideas of liberty, tolerance and progress.

ex.zh: 最高法院将裁决在逮捕期间禁止嫌疑人使用自己的手机是否合法。

ex.zh: 老师把笔记本电脑连接到数字投影仪上。

ex.zh: 博物馆那台老式电影放映机仍然运转完好。

ex.zh: 每间会议室都配有投影仪和大屏幕。

ex.zh: 医生们想尽一切办法延长病人的生命。

ex.zh: 这一争端可能使谈判再拖延数月。

ex.zh: 定期保养可以延长汽车发动机的使用寿命。

senses: adj. 重要的；著名的；突出的；杰出的

ex.zh: 我可以向你保证：朝着这一目标努力的结果就是，最终你和孩子都会从中受益，都会摆脱压力重重的时刻，身心都会感觉更好。

ex.zh: 政府已承诺减税以刺激经济。

ex.zh: 晴朗的天空预示着户外典礼将有一个好天气。

senses: adj. 有前途的；有希望的
adj. 有希望的,有前途的

ex.en: The purpose of editing the News of the World was not to promote reader understanding.
ex.zh: 编辑《世界新闻报》的目的不是为了提升读者的认知。

ex.en: Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.
ex.zh: 下一次如果有人以公司配额来促进性别平等，请记住，这些政策从很大程度上来说只是自私自利的措施，只会让那些政策发起者自我感觉良好，但对普通女性来说帮助甚少。

ex.en: Reading widely can promote the development of critical thinking.
ex.zh: 广泛阅读可以促进批判性思维的发展。

senses: n. 筹办人,发起者,赞助者,倡导者,支持者

ex.en: As a keen promoter of green energy, he has invested heavily in solar power projects.
ex.zh: 作为绿色能源的热心倡导者，他在太阳能项目上投入巨资。

ex.en: The concert promoter was responsible for advertising the event and selling tickets.
ex.zh: 这场音乐会的筹办人负责为活动做广告和销售门票。

ex.zh: 铁路的早期倡导者认为它将改变整个大陆的贸易。

ex.zh: 她的工作主要是销售和广告宣传方面的。

ex.zh: 但根据反贿赂法，证据必须由具体的利益构成。

ex.zh: 调查人员要求有确凿的证据才能结案。

ex.zh: 需要收据作为购买凭证。

ex.zh: 该政权利用宣传来塑造公众舆论并使批评者噤声。

ex.zh: 我们在网上读到的很多东西与其说是信息，不如说是精心设计的宣传。

ex.zh: 专家警告说，选民在社交媒体上越来越多地接触到政治宣传。

ex.zh: 互联网使误导性言论传播的速度远快于辟谣。

ex.en: Most house plants can be propagated easily from cuttings taken in spring.
ex.zh: 大多数室内植物可以很容易地用春季剪下的插枝繁殖。

ex.en: Missionaries travelled thousands of miles to propagate their faith among remote communities.
ex.zh: 传教士跋涉数千英里，在偏远社区传播他们的信仰。

senses: v. 推动，推进；驱使，迫使

ex.zh: 这张照片使她成为国际明星。

ex.zh: 摆脱贫困的渴望驱使他夜以继日地工作。

ex.zh: 新发动机能把这架飞机推进到原先两倍的速度。

ex.zh: 没有适当的培训，新员工很容易犯代价高昂的错误。

ex.zh: 报告建议学校应为儿童提供适当的膳食。

ex.zh: 房地产的价格大幅上升了。

ex.zh: 随着新规于上周三生效，房地产开发商纷纷赶在最后期限前提交方案。

ex.zh: 过去十年里，市中心的房地产价值翻了一番。

ex.zh: 先知警告人们，如果他们不改变自己的行为，这座城市将会陷落。

ex.zh: 他被广泛视为数字时代的预言家，提前几十年就预言了它的影响。

ex.en: In ancient times, a prophet was believed to speak with the authority of the gods.
ex.zh: 在古代，人们相信先知以神明的权威说话。

ex.zh: 他们忽略了细节和比例。

ex.zh: 很大一部分学生来自海外。

ex.en: The proportion of women in senior management has risen steadily.
ex.zh: 高级管理层中女性的比例稳步上升。

ex.zh: 委员会否决了新建停车场的提议。

ex.en: Under the new proposal, workers would pay higher pension contributions.
ex.zh: 根据新方案，工人需缴纳更高的养老保险费。

ex.zh: 她接受了他的求婚。

ex.zh: 远程办公会降低生产率这一观点是一个有争议的主张。

ex.en: Starting a business in a recession is a risky proposition.
ex.zh: 在经济衰退期创业是一件冒险的事。

ex.en: The committee voted against the proposition at last week's meeting.
ex.zh: 委员会在上周的会议上投票否决了这项提议。

prose.usage: 与verse（韵文）相对。prose poem散文诗；近essay n.随笔；短文

senses: v. 起诉，对……提起公诉，告发
prosecute.usage: 派生 prosecution n. 起诉,原告,控方；prosecutor n. 公诉人,检察官；词根记忆：pro(事先)+secut(追踪)+e→事先追踪行迹→起诉；索引p414

ex.en: Among prosecuted firms, those with the most comprehensive corporate social responsibility programmes tended to get more lenient penalties.
ex.zh: 在受到起诉的公司中，那些有最全面的社会责任计划的公司往往会得到较为宽大的处罚。

ex.en: New research suggests that CSR may create monetary value for companies—at least when they are prosecuted for corruption.
ex.zh: 新的研究显示，企业社会责任(CSR)可能会为公司创造出金钱价值——至少当它们面临腐败指控时是如此。

ex.en: The authorities decided to prosecute the company for selling unsafe food.
ex.zh: 当局决定起诉这家公司销售不安全食品。

prosecutor.usage: n.检察官，公诉人；原告律师；索引p414

senses: n. 前途；前景；展望；希望
n. 可能性；前途；前景；（竞赛中的）有望获胜者
prospect.usage: 辨析:prospect指从高处看到的展现在面前的宽广景色;perspective指延绵之远景；n.可能性，希望；预期，展望； 前景 v.勘探，勘察；寻找（商业机会）；pro（表示“往前”）+spect（看）→往前看→前景，展望；词根记忆：pro(向前)+spect(看)→向前看→前景；2011年翻译例：the life

ex.en: If circumstances always determined the life and prospects of people, then humanity would never have progressed.
ex.zh: 如果环境总是决定人们的生活和前景，那么人类就永远不会进步。

ex.en: Although only a research project at this stage, the request has raised the prospect of regulators wading into early-stage tech markets that until now have been beyond their reach.
ex.zh: 尽管该要求在此阶段仅是一个研究项目，但它提高了监管机构涉足早期技术市场的可能性，而初期科技市场是监管机构至今无法触及的领域。

ex.en: Many graduates are worried about their job prospects in an uncertain economy.
ex.zh: 在经济前景不明朗的情况下，许多毕业生对自己的就业前景感到担忧。

senses: adj. 预期的,未来的;可能的
adj. 可能的，潜在的；预期的

ex.en: The company interviews prospective employees carefully before offering them a contract.
ex.zh: 公司在向潜在雇员提供合同之前会仔细进行面试。

ex.en: Prospective students are invited to visit the campus and meet members of the teaching staff.
ex.zh: 学校邀请未来的学生参观校园并与教师会面。

ex.en: Agents must disclose all known defects to prospective buyers of a house.
ex.zh: 中介必须向潜在的购房者披露所有已知的房屋缺陷。

senses: v. 兴旺,繁荣,昌盛,成功
prosper.usage: 辨析：thrive 一般指有生命的事物长势良好；prosper 指人或事业蓬勃发展；flourish 指植物叶茂生长得好,也指事物繁荣或进展得好；反义 decline v. 下降,衰退；pro（前，向前）+sper（希望）→向前走就有希望，会越来越好的→繁荣，兴旺；词根记忆: pro(forward, 向前)+sper

ex.en: The railway prospered from the new mining traffic.
ex.zh: 这条铁路由于新的采矿运输而兴旺发达起来。

ex.en: Small businesses prospered in the decades following the war.
ex.zh: 战后几十年间小企业蓬勃发展。

ex.en: His farm prospered once he began using modern techniques.
ex.zh: 自从采用现代技术后，他的农场兴旺起来。

prosperity.usage: [族] prosperous a. 繁荣的；[族]prosperous a. 繁荣的；索引p414

ex.en: It makes for economic prosperity.
ex.zh: 它有利于经济繁荣。

ex.en: Kennedy wrote that the rule "limited states' ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field."
ex.zh: 肯尼迪还写道，该规定“限制了国家寻求长期繁荣的能力，并阻碍了市场参与者们在公平的市场环境中互相竞争”。

ex.en: Trade with neighbouring countries brought great prosperity to the coastal region.
ex.zh: 与邻国的贸易给沿海地区带来了巨大的繁荣。

prosperous.usage: pro-（向前）+sper（希望）+-ous→希望在前→兴旺的。prosper vi.兴旺；prosperity n.繁荣；adj.繁荣的，富足的；索引p414

ex.en: The city became prosperous through international trade and tourism.
ex.zh: 这座城市通过国际贸易和旅游业繁荣起来。

ex.en: He was born in a prosperous family that owned several factories.
ex.zh: 他出生在一个拥有几家工厂的富裕家庭。

ex.en: The 1990s were a prosperous decade for the national economy.
ex.zh: 二十世纪九十年代是国民经济繁荣的十年。

protect.usage: 辨析：protect 是以掩护物或其他障碍物来避开危害；defend 着重目前的危险,用武力或其他对策来保护；索引p414

ex.en: What motivated him, we were to understand, was his zeal for "fundamental fairness"—protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending and ensuring that only the most deserving claimants received their benefits.
ex.zh: 我们要明白，驱使他这样做的是他对"基本公平"的热忱——保护纳税人，控制支出，并且确保只有最需要的申请者才能得到救济金。

ex.en: New regulations have been introduced to protect consumers from misleading advertising.
ex.zh: 新规已出台，以保护消费者免受误导性广告的侵害。

ex.en: Laws were passed to protect the rights of workers in dangerous industries.
ex.zh: 已通过法律保护危险行业工人的权利。

senses: n. 保护,防卫;保护物,护身符;保险
n. 贸易保护,关税保护制;保护费
n. 保护；防护；保险；保护措施
protection.usage: 另：privacy protection 隐私保护；索引p414

senses: adj. 保护的；防护的；呵护的

ex.en: A balanced diet should contain enough protein to support muscle growth and repair.
ex.zh: 均衡的饮食应含有足够的蛋白质，以支持肌肉的生长和修复。

ex.en: Beans and nuts are cheap sources of protein for people who rarely eat meat.
ex.zh: 对于很少吃肉的人来说，豆类和坚果是廉价的蛋白质来源。

ex.en: Scientists have identified the protein responsible for transmitting signals between nerve cells.
ex.zh: 科学家已经发现了负责在神经细胞之间传递信号的蛋白质。

protest.usage: 记：pro-(公开)+test(证据)→公开拿证据反对→抗议；[族]protester n.抗议者；[近]object vi.反对；n./v.抗议，反对；词根记忆：pro(提出)+test(看到)→目睹事件后提出抗议→抗议；protest against/at/about 抗议；作名词重音在前。；索引p414

ex.en: cause a storm of protest
ex.zh: 引起抗议风潮

ex.en: This has resulted in protests from social scientists.
ex.zh: 这已经激起了社会科学家们的抗议。

ex.en: Thousands of people protested against the new law.
ex.zh: 数千人抗议新法律。

senses: n. (国家之间的)条约,议定书
n. (数据传递的)协议;科学实验计划,医疗方案

proud.usage: 辨析：haughty 傲慢的,是非常高傲的意思；proud 傲慢的,特指不肯让步的意思

senses: v. ①证明，证实②检验，考验，鉴定
prove.usage: v.证实，证明；发酵；prove 可作系动词：prove (to be) + adj.；proof n. 证明，证据。；索引p414

ex.en: American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
ex.zh: 美国企业将面临来自数十个国家的一连串不同税收，这些税收将被证明是繁重且昂贵的。

ex.en: The theory proved to be correct.
ex.zh: 这个理论被证明是正确的。

ex.en: The new regulations may prove difficult to enforce in rural areas.
ex.zh: 新法规在农村地区可能难以执行。

senses: vt. 提供；（法律或协议）规定

phrases.p: provide sth. for sb./sb. with sth.

phrases.m: 提供充足的食物和药品

ex.en: The contract provides that any dispute shall be settled by arbitration.
ex.zh: 合同规定，任何争议都应通过仲裁解决。

ex.en: Volunteers provide hot meals and shelter for homeless people during the winter.
ex.zh: 志愿者在冬天为无家可归者提供热食和住所。

ex.en: The new fund will provide support for students from low-income families.
ex.zh: 新基金将为低收入家庭的学生提供资助。

senses: conj. 倘若，只要，假如，在……条件下

ex.en: "Carry a book with you at all times" can actually work, too—providing you dip in often enough, so that reading becomes the default state from which you temporarily surface to take care of business, before dropping back down.
ex.zh: “随时随身携带一本书”事实上也会奏效，前提是你经常沉浸其中，足以令阅读成为一种默认状态：你能暂时从中跳出来处理一下事情后便马上又能读进去。

senses: adj. 省的,一级行政区的;首都以外的;心胸狭隘的;守旧的
provincial.usage: adj.省的；外省的；守旧的 n.乡下人；索引p414

ex.en: provincial government
ex.zh: 省政府

ex.en: The new museum reflects a provincial culture that is often ignored by the capital.
ex.zh: 这座新博物馆反映出一种常被首都忽视的外省文化。

ex.en: His provincial attitudes made it hard for him to adapt to life abroad.
ex.zh: 他守旧的观念使他难以适应国外的生活。

senses: v. 为……提供所需物品(尤指食物)
n. 供应，提供；准备；条款，规定
provision.usage: 这个单词的动词我们很熟悉：provide（提供）。；索引p414

ex.en: Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions.
ex.zh: 相反，数字服务税是大势所趋，各国在过去几年提出或实施了一系列以首字母缩写命名的新的国际税收规定。

ex.en: The contract contains a provision allowing either side to end the agreement.
ex.zh: 合同包含一项允许任何一方终止协议的条款。

ex.en: The provision of clean drinking water remains a challenge in many regions.
ex.zh: 在许多地区，提供清洁饮用水仍是一项挑战。

senses: adj. 挑衅的,煽动性的,激起争端的;引诱的;激起性欲的

provoke.usage: pro（向前）+vok（喊）→喊到面前→激怒→激起。近义：incite vt. 煽动；激起；pro-（向前）+vok（喊）→冲人喊叫→激怒。provocation n.挑衅；provocative a.挑衅的；词根记忆: pro(forward, 向前)+vok(call, 叫喊)+e→到别人面前喊叫→激怒；索引p41

ex.en: Economic downturns would provoke a painful technological revolution.
ex.zh: 经济衰退将引发一场痛苦的技术革命。

ex.en: The minister's remarks provoked a fierce debate about immigration policy.
ex.zh: 部长的言论引发了一场关于移民政策的激烈辩论。

ex.en: Animal rights groups provoked public anger by publishing images from the laboratory.
ex.zh: 动物权利组织公布了实验室的照片，激起了公众的愤怒。

senses: adj. (常用于名词前)(时间、顺序等)最接近的,最邻近的
n. 代表权;代理权;代理人,受托人
adj. 谨慎的,小心的;有先见之明的;会打算的
adj. 谨慎的，慎重的；精明的
prudent.usage: prud（判断）+-ent→判断周全的→谨慎的。近cautious a.谨慎的；prudence n.审慎；反义: imprudent；既是骄傲的（proud）人，又是谨慎的（prudent）人。；词根记忆: pr(before, 提前)+ud(look, 看)+ent→提前看→谨慎的；索引p415

ex.en: A prudent people would take out an insurance policy now.
ex.zh: 一个谨慎的民族现在应该采取保护措施了。

ex.en: They had become less materialistic and more financially prudent.
ex.zh: 他们变得没那么物质了，在花销方面更加谨慎。

ex.en: It would be prudent to save some money in case of emergencies.
ex.zh: 存一些钱以备急用是谨慎的做法。

senses: n. (对性问题)大惊小怪,假正经
adj. 引起幻觉的;致幻的;产生迷幻效果的
n. [C] 精神病学家；精神科医生
n. 精神病学家，精神病医生
psychiatrist.usage: n.精神病学家，精神科医生；索引p415

ex.en: The court ordered the defendant to be examined by an independent psychiatrist.
ex.zh: 法院命令由一名独立精神科医生对被告进行检查。

ex.en: A psychiatrist can prescribe medication, whereas most psychologists cannot.
ex.zh: 精神科医生可以开具药物，而大多数心理学家则不能。

ex.en: After months of therapy, her psychiatrist suggested a gradual return to work.
ex.zh: 经过几个月的治疗，她的精神科医生建议她逐步重返工作岗位。

senses: n. 精神病学,精神病治疗法
psychiatry.usage: n.精神病学，精神病治疗学

ex.en: Modern psychiatry treats depression as an illness rather than a moral failing.
ex.zh: 现代精神病学将抑郁症视为一种疾病，而非道德缺陷。

ex.en: He studied medicine before deciding to specialise in psychiatry.
ex.zh: 他在决定专攻精神病学之前学的是普通医学。

ex.en: The conference explored recent advances in child psychiatry.
ex.zh: 会议探讨了儿童精神病学的最新进展。

senses: adj. (药物)对心理或精神有显著影响的
adj. 心理学的;心理的,精神的
psychological.usage: adj.心理的，精神的；心理学 的；另：psychological conditions 心理状况；索引p415

ex.en: Sport psychologists help athletes deal with the psychological pressure of major competitions.
ex.zh: 运动心理学家帮助运动员应对重大比赛的心理压力。

ex.en: There is considerable psychological evidence that children learn through play.
ex.zh: 大量心理学证据表明，儿童通过游戏学习。

ex.en: The constant threat of job losses can do serious psychological harm to employees.
ex.zh: 持续的失业威胁会给员工造成严重的心理伤害。

ex.en: A leading psychologist argues that praise can undermine children's motivation to learn.
ex.zh: 一位著名心理学家认为，表扬会削弱儿童的学习动力。

ex.en: The school employs a psychologist to support pupils with emotional difficulties.
ex.zh: 学校聘请了一名心理学家来帮助有情绪困扰的学生。

ex.en: Psychologists have long debated whether intelligence is fixed or can be trained.
ex.zh: 心理学家长期以来一直在争论智力是天生的还是可以训练的。

senses: n. 心理学,心理,心理特征
psychology.usage: 词根记忆：psycho(mind,心理)+logy(学科)→有关心理的学科→心理学；索引p415

ex.en: She studied psychology at university before becoming a teacher.
ex.zh: 她上大学时学习心理学，后来成了教师。

ex.en: The psychology of consumers plays a key role in advertising.
ex.zh: 消费者心理在广告中起着关键作用。

ex.en: His interest in human psychology led him to a career in research.
ex.zh: 他对人类心理的兴趣使他走上了研究道路。

senses: adj. 平民的,大众的,百姓的
n. 平民,百姓;志趣相同的群体
adj. 公共的；公开的；公众的
public.usage: adj.大众的；公共的；政府的；公 开的 n.公众，大众；索引p415

ex.en: It's also a good idea to delay the conversation if you're in a meeting or other public space.
ex.zh: 如果你们在会议室或在其他公共场所讨论，推迟谈话也是一个好主意。

ex.en: The park is open to the public all year round.
ex.zh: 公园全年对公众开放。

ex.en: Public spending on education has fallen in real terms.
ex.zh: 教育方面的公共支出实际下降了。

senses: n. [sing.] 公营部门；公共部门

publication.usage: n.出版；发行物；刊登，公布；索引p415

ex.en: That's one reason why we have launched Arc, a new publication dedicated to the near future.
ex.zh: 这就是我们出版《圆弧》这本致力于研究不久的将来的新刊物的原因之一。

ex.en: The results of the study are awaiting publication in a leading journal.
ex.zh: 这项研究结果正等待在一家权威期刊上发表。

ex.en: The publication of his first novel brought him instant fame.
ex.zh: 他的第一部小说的出版使他一举成名。

senses: n. （媒体的）关注，报道；宣传；传播工作
publicity.usage: public（公众）+-ity→进入公众视野→宣传。publicize vt.宣传；public relations公共关系；n.（媒体的）关注，报道；宣传， 推广；public(公开的)+ity(名词后缀)→媒体公开的东西→报道

ex.en: There has been a great deal of publicity surrounding his disappearance.
ex.zh: 他的失踪已被媒体广泛报道。

ex.en: The concert received widespread publicity in the local media.
ex.zh: 这场音乐会在当地媒体上得到了广泛宣传。

ex.en: The company used the scandal as free publicity for its new film.
ex.zh: 该公司把这场丑闻用作其新片的免费宣传。

senses: vt. 出版；发行；发表，刊登；公布；发布
v. 出版，发行，发表；公开

ex.en: They publish more than 1.2 million articles each year in some 16,000 journals.
ex.zh: 他们每年在大约16000种期刊上发表120多万篇文章。

ex.en: The journal refuses to publish papers whose data cannot be verified.
ex.zh: 该期刊拒绝发表数据无法核实的论文。

ex.en: The ministry will publish the examination results on its official website.
ex.zh: 该部委将在其官方网站上公布考试成绩。

senses: n. 出版人（或机构），发行人（或机构）
publisher.usage: n.出版者，出版商；发行人；索引p415

ex.en: The publisher refused to print the book because of its political content.
ex.zh: 出版商因该书的政治内容而拒绝出版。

ex.en: She works as an editor for a major academic publisher.
ex.zh: 她在一家大型学术出版机构担任编辑。

ex.en: The publisher plans to release the memoir next spring.
ex.zh: 出版商计划明年春天出版这部回忆录。

senses: v. 气喘吁吁；抽(香烟等)；冒出(烟气等)

ex.en: He took a long puff at his pipe and began to tell his story.
ex.zh: 他深深地吸了一口烟斗，开始讲述自己的经历。

ex.en: After climbing the steep hill, the old man was puffing hard.
ex.zh: 爬上陡峭的山坡后，老人气喘吁吁。

ex.en: A puff of wind blew the papers off the desk.
ex.zh: 一阵风吹走了桌上的文件。

senses: v. 用泵抽吸,用泵抽送
n. 冲压机,冲床,穿孔机
punch.usage: punch line妙语；笑点；punch in/out上下班打卡。近hit vt.打；box vi.拳击；n.一拳，一击； v.用拳猛击；索引p415

ex.en: He punched the man in the face during the argument.
ex.zh: 争吵中他一拳打在那名男子的脸上。

ex.en: Use this tool to punch a hole in the leather belt.
ex.zh: 用这个工具在皮带上打一个孔。

ex.en: Employees punch a time clock when they arrive at work.
ex.zh: 员工上班时要打考勤卡。

senses: adj. 严守时刻的,准时的,正点的
punctual.usage: punct（点；变尖）+ual（有……性质的）→卡在点上的→准时的。

ex.en: He is always punctual for his class.
ex.zh: 他上课总是很准时。

ex.en: Employees are expected to be punctual, since late arrivals disrupt the whole team.
ex.zh: 员工应准时到岗，因为迟到会打乱整个团队的工作。

ex.en: The airline is rarely punctual, so passengers are advised to allow extra time.
ex.zh: 这家航空公司很少准点，建议乘客预留额外的时间。

senses: n. [U] 标点符号；标点符号用法
n. 标点符号；标点符号用法

ex.en: Good punctuation is essential to clear writing, since a misplaced comma can change the meaning of a sentence.
ex.zh: 良好的标点使用对清晰的写作至关重要，因为一个放错位置的逗号可能改变句子的含义。

ex.en: Examiners deduct marks for spelling and punctuation errors in the essay.
ex.zh: 阅卷人会因为文章中的拼写和标点错误而扣分。

ex.en: The editor spent hours correcting the punctuation in the manuscript.
ex.zh: 编辑花了几个小时修改手稿中的标点。

senses: vt. 处罚，惩罚；惩处（犯罪行为）
v. 处罚，惩罚；对……判罪；自责
punish.usage: v.处罚，惩罚；发音类似"怕你失(迷失自己)"→妈妈严格管教做错事会惩罚你

ex.en: My parents used to punish me by not letting me watch TV.
ex.zh: 过去我父母常以不让我看电视来惩罚我。

ex.en: The law punishes companies that dump waste into rivers.
ex.zh: 该法律惩处向河里倾倒废物的公司。

ex.en: He was punished for cheating in the examination.
ex.zh: 他因考试作弊而受到处罚。

ex.en: severe punishment
ex.zh: 严厉的惩罚

ex.en: Many psychologists argue that physical punishment does more harm than good.
ex.zh: 许多心理学家认为体罚弊大于利。

ex.en: Critics claim the punishment rarely fits the crime in the current system.
ex.zh: 批评者称，在现行制度下惩罚很少与罪行相称。

senses: n. [C] 学生；小学生；弟子；门生；瞳孔

purchase.usage: 比 buy 正式；n./v.购买，采购 英国royal决定出资reward英国postal系统，并combine相关campaign和媒体comment 来缓解邮政发展和时代进步的conflict，并缓解邮政的debt crisis.；pur（联想成purse“钱包”）+chase（追逐）→用钱包追逐→购买；索引p41

ex.en: An international travel insurance policy is usually purchased in your home country before you go abroad.
ex.zh: 国际旅游保险单通常是在你出国之前在国内购买。

ex.en: It may be that the value of Whole Foods to Amazon is not so much the 460 shops it owns, but the records of which customers have purchased what.
ex.zh: 全食超市对亚马逊的价值可能不在于其所拥有的460家门店，而在于其顾客的消费记录。

ex.en: Customers can purchase tickets online at a lower price.
ex.zh: 顾客可以在网上以更低的价格购票。

pure.usage: 派生 purity n. 纯净,纯洁

purify.usage: pur（纯）+-ify（使……）→使纯净→净化。purification n.净化；pure a.纯的；[族]pure 纯的；纯净的；纯粹的；purifier 净化器

senses: n. 禁欲者,苦行者,清教徒
adj. 清教徒的,清教主义的,禁欲的,苦行的
puritan.usage: n.禁欲者；清教徒 adj.清教徒的；禁欲的

ex.en: The puritans who settled in New England sought to build a society based on strict religious principles.
ex.zh: 定居新英格兰的清教徒试图建立一个以严格宗教原则为基础的社会。

ex.en: Early puritan settlers believed that hard work was a religious duty.
ex.zh: 早期清教徒移民相信勤奋工作是一种宗教义务。

ex.en: He had a puritan dislike of waste and luxury of any kind.
ex.zh: 他像清教徒一样厌恶任何形式的浪费和奢侈。

ex.en: It was the purpose and responsibility of great minds to go forth and seek out the truth, which they believed to be founded in knowledge.
ex.zh: 伟大思想家的目标和责任就是不断前进、探求真理，他们相信真理根植于知识之中。

ex.en: The purpose of the meeting is to review the company's plans for the coming year.
ex.zh: 此次会议的目的是审查公司来年的计划。

ex.en: After retiring, she found a new sense of purpose in charity work.
ex.zh: 退休后，她在慈善工作中找到了新的意义感。

senses: v. 继续探讨（或从事）；追赶；追求；致力于
vt. 追求；继续探讨(或追究、从事)；追赶
pursue.usage: pursuant adj.依据的,按照的;反义escape v.逃跑,逃脱；v.追求；继续探讨；追逐，追赶；pur（=pro，表示“前”）+sue（跟随）→向前跟随→追踪，追随，追求；词根记忆：pur(before,前)+su(follow,跟踪)+e→追踪前方的人→追赶。；索引p415

ex.en: She wishes to pursue a medical career.
ex.zh: 她希望从事医学工作。

ex.en: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving "to pursue my goal of running a company."
ex.zh: 他没有用一些常见的模棱两可的借口掩饰自己的离去，反而坦言离职是为了"追求自己经营一家公司的目标"。

ex.en: After years in business, he chose to pursue an academic career.
ex.zh: 从商多年后，他选择了从事学术工作。

senses: n. 追求；追赶；实行；爱好

ex.en: academic pursuit
ex.zh: 学术追求

ex.en: The pursuit of wealth for its own sake rarely brings lasting happiness.
ex.zh: 单纯为财富而追求财富很少能带来持久的幸福。

ex.en: The police chased the thieves through the streets in hot pursuit.
ex.zh: 警察紧追不舍，在街上追捕窃贼。

senses: vt. 放；安置；猛推；用力插入；说；表达

phrases.m: 思索,集中思想考虑(问题等)

puzzle.usage: 同义confusion,mystery,perplexity；v.使困惑，迷惑 n.智力游戏,迷惑；发音类似"趴着"→这个孩子在地面上趴着玩"拼图"→拼图；索引p415

ex.en: This question has puzzled scientists for decades.
ex.zh: 这个问题已经困惑科学家数十载。

ex.en: What puzzles the author is that some bosses fail to see the link between trust and data protection.
ex.zh: 令作者困惑的是，一些老板未能看到信任和数据保护之间的联系。

ex.en: The disappearance of the ancient civilization still puzzles historians.
ex.zh: 这个古代文明的消失仍然令历史学家困惑。

senses: adj. 令人迷惑的，令人费解的
n. 金字塔(尤指古埃及的)
n. 呈金字塔形的组织或系统；金字塔

ex.en: One reason for the persistence of this pyramid of production is that for the past half-century, much of the world's media culture has been defined by a single medium—television—and television is defined by downloading.
ex.zh: 形成这种金字塔式的生产结构的原因之一就是，在过去的半个世纪，大部分的世界媒体文化都被电视这种单一媒体所定义，而电视的特性就是下载。

ex.en: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids as tombs for their kings.
ex.zh: 古埃及人建造金字塔作为国王的陵墓。

ex.en: Large organisations tend to have a pyramid structure, with few decision-makers at the top.
ex.zh: 大型组织往往呈金字塔结构，顶层决策者很少。

senses: a./det. 涉及四个的；四倍的

qualification.usage: n.资格，学历；获得资格，达到 标准；索引p415

ex.en: He has all the right qualifications for the post of sales director.
ex.zh: 他具备销售总监这一职位所需的一切合格资历。

ex.en: A degree is the minimum qualification for most professional jobs.
ex.zh: 学位是大多数专业工作的最低资格要求。

ex.en: She gained a teaching qualification after two years of training.
ex.zh: 经过两年培训，她获得了教师资格证书。

senses: adj. 具备……的学历（或资历）；具备……的知识（或技能）；符合资格
qualified.usage: adj.具备资历的；胜任的；索引p415

ex.en: She's extremely well qualified for the job.
ex.zh: 她完全符合承担这项工作的条件。

ex.en: Since students and parents expect a college degree to lead to a job, it is in the best interest of a school to turn out graduates who are as qualified as possible—or at least appear to be.
ex.zh: 由于学生和家长都希望学生凭借大学学位获得一份工作，因此，培养尽可能合格（或至少看起来合格）的毕业生符合学校的最大利益。

ex.en: Only qualified doctors are permitted to prescribe this powerful drug.
ex.zh: 只有具备资格的医生才可以开具这种强效药物。

senses: v. ①使具有资格，证明合格，使有权(做某事)
v. 使具备资格；取得资格（或学历）；合格
qualify.usage: v.（使）有权去做；取得资格， 达到标准；使合格；字面意思"使……有质量"→使你有质量当老师即有资格；派生qualified adj.；索引p415

ex.en: This training course will qualify you for a better job.
ex.zh: 本培训课程将使你能胜任更好的工作。

ex.en: Only the top two teams qualify for the final round.
ex.zh: 只有排名前两的队伍才有资格进入决赛。

ex.en: His experience qualifies him as an ideal candidate for the position.
ex.zh: 他的经历使他有资格成为该职位的理想人选。

ex.en: The study combines quantitative data with qualitative interviews to give a fuller picture.
ex.zh: 该研究将定量数据与定性访谈相结合，以呈现更全面的图景。

ex.en: There has been a qualitative change in the relationship between the two countries.
ex.zh: 两国关系发生了质的变化。

ex.en: Qualitative research explores why people behave in certain ways, not just how often they do so.
ex.zh: 定性研究探究人们为何以某种方式行事，而不仅仅是行为的频率。

quality.usage: n.质量，品质；优质，品德；特质 adj.优质的，高质量的；索引p415

ex.en: The quality of service in this hotel has declined sharply.
ex.zh: 这家酒店的服务质量急剧下降。

ex.en: She shows all the qualities of an excellent leader.
ex.zh: 她显示出一名优秀领导者的各种品质。

ex.en: Customers are willing to pay extra for goods of good quality.
ex.zh: 顾客愿意为质量好的商品多付钱。

senses: vt. 确定……的数量,用数量表示,测量
quantify.usage: quant（数量）+-ify→确定数量→量化。quantity n.数量；quantitative a.定量的；quant(数量)+ify(动词后缀,使……)→用数量表示

quantitative.usage: [族]quantitatively ad.数量上，量化地；quantity n.数量；数额；quantit(y)(数量)+ative(形容词后缀)→数量的；adj.数量的，量化的，定量的

ex.en: A quantitative analysis of the survey results confirmed the researchers' initial hypothesis.
ex.zh: 对调查结果的定量分析证实了研究人员的初步假设。

ex.en: The course teaches students basic quantitative methods used in social science.
ex.zh: 本课程教授社会科学中常用的基本定量方法。

ex.en: Without quantitative evidence, it is hard to measure the policy's true impact.
ex.zh: 没有定量证据，就很难衡量政策的真实影响。

ex.en: The police found a large quantity of drugs hidden in the vehicle.
ex.zh: 警方在这辆车里发现了大量隐藏的毒品。

ex.en: A vast quantity of data is collected every time we use a search engine.
ex.zh: 我们每次使用搜索引擎都会收集到海量数据。

ex.en: Producers prefer quality to quantity when the market is weak.
ex.zh: 市场疲软时，生产商重质不重量。

senses: n. (为预防传染的)隔离期;检疫
v. (对动物或人)进行检疫;隔离
n. 争吵；抱怨（或不赞成）的理由
n. 争论，争辩，口角；争论的原因
quarrel.usage: 发音类似"口哦"→需要用口说出来哦→争辩，争论

ex.en: He got involved in a quarrel with his neighbour.
ex.zh: 他和邻居吵了一架。

ex.en: The two parties settled their quarrel over property boundaries out of court.
ex.zh: 双方庭外解决了关于地产边界的争执。

ex.en: I have no quarrel with the plan itself, only with its timing.
ex.zh: 我对该计划本身没有异议，只是不赞成其实施时机。

senses: n. 夸脱(液体或固体的容积单位)

phrases.p: put a quart into a pint pot
phrases.m: 将…置于容不下之处,徒劳

senses: adj. 古怪的，反常的，奇特的
queer.usage: 她是个脾气古怪的（queer）女王（queen）。

ex.en: There was something queer about the way the machine stopped without any warning.
ex.zh: 那台机器毫无预警地停了下来，有些古怪。

ex.en: She noticed a queer light in the sky shortly before the storm began.
ex.zh: 暴风雨来临前不久，她注意到天空中有一道奇特的光。

ex.en: It is queer that he left without saying a word to anyone.
ex.zh: 奇怪的是，他一句话也没说就离开了。

quench.usage: quench one's thirst解渴；quench hatred消除仇恨。近extinguish vt.熄灭

ex.en: People are invited to query Marilyn vos Savant, who at age 10 had tested at a mental level of someone about 23 years old; that gave her an IQ of 228—the highest score ever recorded.
ex.zh: 人们被邀请向玛丽莲·沃斯·萨万特提问，她在10岁时就做过适合23岁左右的人的智力测试；结果显示她的智商228——有记录以来的最高分。

ex.en: If you have a query about your order, please contact customer service.
ex.zh: 如果您对订单有疑问，请联系客服。

ex.en: Economists have begun to query whether the recovery is sustainable.
ex.zh: 经济学家开始质疑这种复苏是否可持续。

senses: n. 探索，寻找，追求(幸福等)
quest.usage: question的近源词→追问→探求。in quest of=in search of；quest for寻求；索引p415

ex.en: in the quest for circulation and impact
ex.zh: 追求发行量和影响力

ex.en: He devoted his life to the quest for truth and justice.
ex.zh: 他毕生致力于对真理与正义的探求。

ex.en: The company is on a quest to develop cleaner energy sources.
ex.zh: 该公司正努力寻求开发更清洁的能源。

senses: n. 问题；怀疑；（待讨论或处理的）事情

ex.en: It is fair to criticize and question the mechanism—that is the culture of research, after all—but it is the prize-givers' money to do with as they please.
ex.zh: 对于这一（奖励）机制提出批评和质疑是合理的——毕竟，这正是研究的文化——但那是奖项设立者的钱，他们想怎么花就怎么花。

ex.en: The police questioned the witness for several hours about the night of the accident.
ex.zh: 警方就事故当晚对目击者讯问了数小时。

ex.en: Whether the new policy will actually cut emissions remains an open question.
ex.zh: 新政策是否真能减少排放仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

senses: a. 可疑的；有问题的；别有用心的
adj. 可疑的;有问题的;未必准确(或正确)的
adj. 可能不诚实(或不道德)的;别有用心的
n. (统计或调查用的)问卷，征求意见表

ex.en: Researchers distributed a questionnaire to 500 households in the district.
ex.zh: 研究人员向该地区500户家庭发放了调查问卷。

ex.en: Please complete the questionnaire and return it before the end of the month.
ex.zh: 请填写问卷并于月底前交回。

ex.en: The questionnaire revealed that most employees were satisfied with their working hours.
ex.zh: 问卷显示，大多数员工对自己的工作时间感到满意。

senses: n. (排队等候的)一队人,一行列车
a. 快的；短暂的；很快发生的
adv. 迅速地，快(置于动词后，等于 quickly)
a. 机敏的；聪颖的；机智的
a. 轻声的；僻静的；平静的
n. [C] 怪癖；怪异的性格；奇事，巧合
v. 离开(工作职位、学校等)；停止
quit.usage: 同义 discontinue，resign；反义 stay；索引p415

ex.en: He quit the show last year because of bad health.
ex.zh: 去年他因身体欠佳而退出了表演。

ex.en: She quit her job to spend more time with her family.
ex.zh: 她辞去工作，以便有更多时间陪伴家人。

ex.en: Doctors advised him to quit smoking immediately.
ex.zh: 医生建议他立即戒烟。

senses: ad. 相当；非常；在很大程度上；很；的确；正是

quiver.usage: 拟声拟态词。近tremble vi.发抖；shake v.摇动。an arrow in the quiver箭在弦上

senses: n. 测验,考查,问答比赛
n. 配额,定额,(人或事物的)最高限额

quote.usage: 同义 cite；quotation 照搬原文引用，citation 引用可有出入，reference 仅指参考；派生 quotation n. 引文；v./n.引用，引述；发音类似"夸她"，想要夸她可以引用倾国倾城

ex.en: He was widely quoted in the American media.
ex.zh: 他被美国媒体广泛引用。

ex.en: She quoted a line from Shakespeare to make her point.
ex.zh: 她引用莎士比亚的一句话来阐明自己的观点。

ex.en: The report quoted figures from several government studies.
ex.zh: 该报告引用了几项政府研究的数据。

race.usage: 助记:race(赛跑)前必须把lace(鞋带)系紧；n.赛跑；竞争；种族 v.参加比赛；（使）快速移动

ex.en: She was determined to win the race, despite training for only a month.
ex.zh: 尽管只训练了一个月，她仍决心赢得这场比赛。

ex.en: The new law bans discrimination on the grounds of race, gender or religion.
ex.zh: 新法律禁止基于种族、性别或宗教的歧视。

ex.en: Companies are in a race to develop safer self-driving technology.
ex.zh: 各公司正在竞相开发更安全的自动驾驶技术。

racial.usage: raci(e)(种族)+al→种族的;派生racialist n.种族主义者;racialism n.种族主义,种族偏见；rac(种族，人种)+ial(形容词后缀)→人种的，种族的

ex.en: He struggled to overcome racial prejudice.
ex.zh: 他努力克服种族偏见。

ex.en: The new law bans racial discrimination in the workplace.
ex.zh: 新法律禁止工作场所的种族歧视。

ex.en: The city has a long history of racial tension.
ex.zh: 这座城市种族关系紧张由来已久。

senses: n. 种族主义，种族歧视
n. (肉体或精神上的)剧烈痛苦
v. 使(肉体或精神上)受剧烈痛苦,折磨

racket.usage: 助记:rocket(火箭)发射场地十分racket(喧闹)

senses: adj. 光芒四射的；容光焕发的
adj. ①发光的，辐射的，照耀的
adj. 灿烂的；辐射的；喜气洋洋的；容光焕发的，面色红润的

ex.en: She was radiant with health.
ex.zh: 她身体健康，容光焕发。

ex.en: The bride looked radiant as she walked into the church.
ex.zh: 新娘走进教堂时容光焕发。

ex.en: The room was warmed by radiant heat from the stove.
ex.zh: 房间靠火炉的辐射热取暖。
